# Helvetica Neue Roman

The gameplay UI uses `HelveticaNeueRoman.otf`, copied from the project owner's
locally installed Helvetica Neue family on `2026-08-09`. It replaces the visibly
narrow Roboto Condensed face and is loaded from Unity Resources so release builds
do not depend on an operating-system font lookup.

Runtime OTF SHA-256:
`E4D3DBBC47526BD5956A39AEDCF08D8A3CA4970D7A935B39EC99BB217D6035C3`

This is a user-supplied proprietary font asset. No license is inferred or
redistributed by this repository note; the project owner remains responsible for
keeping the asset within the rights attached to their installed copy.
